regime: Tariff scare before the open: tech futures and metals slide while volatility jumps
takeaway: A report that the US may put new tariffs on 16 trading partners has Nasdaq 100 futures down over 2% and the VIX up about 15% to 30, matching the volatility-spike and tech-led-selloff patterns. Gold is off about 0.9% near a 14-month low and silver about 1.4%, pushing the gold/silver ratio to about 87.6, which fits the silver-under-stress and gold-downtrend checks; junior miners are down more than gold before the open. October PCE inflation came in at 3.8% with core at 3.3%, a touch above the 3.2% forecast, as markets already price a December Fed hike; the yen is flat, so there is no sign of a carry unwind.
